skills.name: SEO Skill: Local CLI
skills.one_liner: Run bounded local crawl, sitemap-health and single-page reports without a paid SEO API.

license.verification: Pinned LICENSE and package.json reviewed. Project names and artwork have a separate trademark policy.

agents.note: Upstream documents skill/CLI and MCP integration. No agent install or runtime compatibility test has been performed.

dependencies: npm package seo, reviewed source version 0.2.41
Local shell and filesystem for CLI mode, or a configured local stdio MCP client
Browser installation may be needed for rendering/Lighthouse paths; raw HTTP crawl does not establish rendered-page evidence
Runtime packages include undici, robots-parser, linkedom, libsql, lighthouse and playwright-core; see pinned package.json

cost.commercial_api_required: No for local technical crawling, sitemap health and audit-page. Google sign-in and paid research providers are optional and excluded from the starter route.
cost.summary: Apache-2.0 package with no separate subscription for local technical reports. Existing agent/model charges still apply.
cost.guardrail: Use a supplied public URL. Do not run seo start, connect Google, add providers, enable enrichment, submit IndexNow or buy anything in this exercise.

permissions_and_risks: Makes direct HTTP requests to target sites; browser rendering can load third-party page resources. Bound host, pages and depth.
Writes local caches, settings and report files. Keep them out of the public teaching repository.
Anonymous telemetry is enabled by default according to PRIVACY.md. Set DO_NOT_TRACK=1 before the first CLI run to opt out.
The skill tells the agent to install an unpinned global npm package when missing. Do not follow that automatically: review and approve a pinned install first.
The suite can connect accounts, store tokens, use paid providers, edit source and send IndexNow notifications. These are outside this starter scope.
Host agents may send tool outputs to their model provider. Local execution does not guarantee offline/private model processing.
skills.starter_scope: Read-only public-site analysis, starting with one page or a bounded 10-page crawl. No login, credentials, paid provider, source edits or external submissions.
skills.suggested_prompt: Use the installed local SEO skill to inspect <PUBLIC_URL>. Read-only, no paid APIs, Google sign-in, providers, editing, publishing, IndexNow or automatic installation. Set DO_NOT_TRACK=1. First verify the installed version. Discover and describe the appropriate report before constructing parameters. Bound a crawl to 10 pages, depth 1, the supplied host, no external-link checks, and disable sitemap expansion for that crawl. For single-page review use audit-page. Save complete JSON, then summarize three findings with evidence and limits. Stop on authentication, denial or unclear scope.
expected_output: Bounded crawl or page evidence in JSON
Observed response, metadata and indexability signals
not_for: A complete site audit from a small crawl
Proving real-user Core Web Vitals from static HTML
Automatic changes to robots, canonical or noindex without confirming intent

safe_start_examples.purpose: Bounded raw crawl after reviewing installed help
safe_start_examples.note: Check installed help and respect target access/rate limits. No claim of successful execution.

execution.input: Two original canonical-conflict HTML fixtures served over loopback HTTP
execution.limitations: Raw HTTP only. No agent integration, broad crawl, sitemap report, hosted API or indexing test.

license.verification: Pinned LICENSE file and skill frontmatter reviewed.

agents.note: This source is a Claude Code plugin. Do not claim that its CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT paths or slash commands work unchanged in Codex or Cursor. A separate Codex port is mentioned upstream but is outside this review.

dependencies: Python >=3.10; upstream recommends 3.11+ for new installs
Pinned repository runtime and shared scripts, not just the SKILL.md file
Python packages in requirements.txt, including requests, BeautifulSoup, lxml and extraction libraries
Playwright Chromium for JavaScript rendering/screenshots; setup may install it

cost.commercial_api_required: No for the core workflow. Optional enrichment extensions require separate accounts and may be paid.
cost.summary: MIT skill with no per-domain fee. Claude/model costs and optional API usage remain separate.
cost.guardrail: Do not enable or call optional Google, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, or other extensions for the starter exercise.

permissions_and_risks: Fetches target websites and writes local reports.
Setup installs a Python environment and may download Chromium; review pinned setup code before executing.
The host agent's model may receive page content and local context. Local script execution does not mean all processing remains on the device.
Full plugin includes other tools, hooks and integrations outside the scope reviewed here; source-reviewed is not a complete security audit.
skills.name: Claude SEO: Sitemap
skills.one_liner: Discover a sitemap, validate its structure, and turn problems into an evidence-backed fix list.
skills.starter_scope: Analyze an existing sitemap for an authorized public site. Limit page checks and preserve partial results; do not generate or publish a replacement in the first exercise.
skills.suggested_prompt: Use seo-sitemap to inspect <URL>. Start with robots.txt and the sitemap discovery helper. Analyze only; do not generate, upload or submit anything. Limit URL spot checks to 10 and label this as a sample. Return the discovered sitemap URLs, parse errors, sampled URL findings, and a prioritized fix list. Ask before fetching an off-domain sitemap.
expected_output: Prioritized fixes with clear sample coverage
limitations: Discovery follows Sitemap declarations, including cross-host targets. Validate and approve off-domain scope.
Checking 10 URLs cannot validate an entire large sitemap.
A sitemap is a discovery hint, not proof of crawling or indexing.
The upstream generation workflow includes editorial thresholds for location pages; these are not search-engine rules.
skills.recommendation: Useful if Claude Code is already installed. The default cross-agent route uses the local SEO CLI for sitemap health.

skills.name: Firecrawl Scrape
skills.one_liner: Capture one public page as a reusable Markdown or JSON evidence file.

license.verification: Declared in pinned package.json; LICENSE and LICENSE.md at the repository root returned 404. A standalone license grant for the skill directory was not established. Link-only curation; do not redistribute the skill text.

agents.note: CLI README documents these harnesses. Integration has not been installed or tested here.

dependencies: For hosted service: Firecrawl account and authentication
A shell and permission to write local evidence files

cost.commercial_api_required: Hosted path: yes, the Firecrawl API; paid subscription not necessarily required. Self-hosted custom API endpoint is documented but not evaluated here.
cost.summary: Credit-metered hosted service; free tier and paid plans exist. Model/agent costs are additional.
cost.guardrail: Start with one ordinary HTML URL. Avoid paid query/extraction options, PDFs, broad crawl jobs, and automatic top-ups until the user approves a budget.

permissions_and_risks: Sends the target URL and options to Firecrawl; retrieved content is processed by the hosted service.
Uses shell commands and writes local output, conventionally under .firecrawl/.
The skill permits broad firecrawl CLI commands, including capabilities beyond this starter task. Restrict the task to plain URL scraping.
Setup can install skills across all detected agents; scope setup to the intended agent. Do not run setup defaults: it can change the agent's web-provider routing.
Authentication stores credentials and upstream README discloses authentication-time telemetry. Review privacy/settings before signing in.
Remote provider execution, browser interaction, data terms, and paid calls need separate review.
skills.starter_scope: One public HTML page, read-only scrape. No browser interactions, logins, provider tools, forms, or site-wide crawl.
skills.suggested_prompt: Use firecrawl-scrape to read this one public HTML URL: <URL>. Save the result and source URL as local evidence. Use plain scrape only; do not use query mode, crawl, interact, or provider tools. Report missing or partial content. Ask before any paid expansion.
not_for: Proving that Google has indexed a page
skills.recommendation: Not part of the zero-new-paid-API starter route.

default_route.policy: Zero new paid SEO APIs. Existing model/agent costs may apply.
default_route.install_policy: No one-click remote shell or automatic global install. Review a fixed version and dependencies first; do not execute code just because a skill requests it.

mapping.sitemap: local-seo; optional Claude-specific seo-sitemap for deeper XML review

default_route.manual_fallback: If no CLI is installed, use the existing agent's authorized HTTP/browser tools or user-supplied HTML. Inspect status, headers, robots.txt, sitemap and page metadata directly. This is a manual evidence route, not an additional third-party skill.
